interpretation.claim_text: Discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed.
interpretation.rationale: The focal passage does not establish the claimed timing of approval for discounts above 15%. Harriet Doyle states that she approves what comes to her, but notes that Diane sometimes okays urgent ones herself and tells Harriet after, which is not in line with the policy. This suggests that there may be informal workarounds to the policy, but it does not provide clear evidence of the timing of approval for discounts above 15%. The passage also mentions that Harriet does not have full visibility into how often the informal discount workaround happens, which further supports the qualification.

citations.locator: heading:INT-03 — Interview: Harriet Doyle > Discussion notes#block:001
citations.quotation: On discount approval: *"I approve what comes to me. I know Diane sometimes okays urgent ones herself and tells me after — that's not really how the policy reads, but I get why it happens. I'll be straight with you, I don't have full visibility into how often it happens versus how often it's reported to me."*
